steps.code:
# Fetch all liked songs, liked albums, and liked playlists (paginated)
access_token = login_result["access_token"]

def fetch_all(api_func, **kwargs):
    items = []
    page_index = 0
    page_limit = 20
    while True:
        resp = api_func(access_token=access_token, page_index=page_index, page_limit=page_limit, **kwargs)
        # resp is a list of items
        if not resp:
            break
        items.extend(resp)
        if len(resp) < page_limit:
            break
        page_index += 1
    return items

liked_songs = fetch_all(apis.spotify.show_liked_songs)
liked_albums = fetch_all(apis.spotify.show_liked_albums)
liked_playlists = fetch_all(apis.spotify.show_liked_playlists)

steps.code:
# Collect song IDs from liked albums and liked playlists
album_song_ids = set()
for album in liked_albums:
    album_id = album["album_id"]
    album_detail = apis.spotify.show_album(album_id=album_id)
    for song in album_detail["songs"]:
        album_song_ids.add(song["id"])

playlist_song_ids = set()
for pl in liked_playlists:
    pl_id = pl["playlist_id"]
    pl_detail = apis.spotify.show_playlist(playlist_id=pl_id, access_token=access_token)
    for song in pl_detail["songs"]:
        playlist_song_ids.add(song["id"])

# Also get liked songs IDs
liked_song_ids = set(song["song_id"] for song in liked_songs)

# Merge all unique song IDs
all_song_ids = liked_song_ids | album_song_ids | playlist_song_ids
print("Total unique song IDs:", len(all_song_ids))
print("Liked songs:", len(liked_song_ids))
print("Album songs:", len(album_song_ids))
print("Playlist songs:", len(playlist_song_ids))
